items.html: And it was explained how the drop of MB is one Mayin Duchrin [male waters] from Chochma, which is the Yud-Hei-Vav of the Milui of the Heyin, and they are two drops of Mayin Nukvin, the two names Ahyh of Yudin, which are in the simple, in the Milui, and in the Milui of the Milui, twice forty-two letters. And thus was explained this upper coupling of kisses of Arich, which is from the Chochma, the Sealed Brain within it, with the Bina within it, which is in the throat, through the palate, which is the Yesod of Chochma, as above. And since this coupling is in the mouth, it is called the coupling of kisses. And now understand the matter of the kisses mentioned everywhere, which is the coupling of the palate with the throat.
